rows.label: tlk47300162_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Our village's biggest success story,
Rex, is back!

rows.label: tlk47300162_01_msg0002
rows.name:
What do you think? Good wood, right?
Liberalitas has few trees, so we raise
each one carefully and use it all.

rows.label: tlk47300162_01_msg0003
rows.name:
The village buildings are the same.
We repair and maintain them, then pass
them down to our children.

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0004
rows.name:
That building at town's edge
is getting old, so they're
deciding what to use it for.
